design.direction: calm, credible energy infrastructure with an Indonesian editorial warmth

palette.ink: deep forest blue-black for primary type and navigation
palette.accent: sunlit amber for calls to action and energy cues
palette.surface: warm ivory with pale mist-blue panels
palette.support: muted sage for operational and sustainability notes

design.type: strong compact display headlines paired with quiet, highly legible sans-serif body copy
design.imagery: wide documentary photography of renewable infrastructure, field operations, and people at work; natural light, no text or logos

assets.prompt: Wide documentary photograph of a solar field and wind turbines at first light in an Indonesian landscape, calm confident atmosphere, generous open sky and clean negative space for website copy, natural warm dawn light, subtle deep blue and amber palette, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Editorial documentary photograph of two energy technicians in safety gear inspecting renewable-energy equipment at a clean modern solar and battery facility, candid collaboration, textured industrial detail, soft daylight, restrained forest blue and amber accents, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Warm editorial group portrait of a diverse Indonesian energy team standing together at a modern renewable-energy site, approachable and capable, natural late-afternoon light, subtle landscape context, authentic documentary photography, no text, no logos, no watermark.
